id: title:Gilbert09:retry read timeouts and connection errors

review.posthog_relevance: Adds network resilience to database analysis workflow, P1
review.reason: Adds requests.ReadTimeout and requests.ConnectionError to the retry condition alongside PgAnalyzeRetryableError, P1.F1.H2. This establishes a bounded, substantive improvement in reliability for the database analysis workflow by handling transient network failures, P1. No tier 2 or 3 systemic benefit established.
